title: Keep product buttons separate from description links
summary: A product card can contain a guide link in its description and a separate Buy button. Import should identify the actual product button and preserve its destination. A card without a button must remain without one.
validation_docs: Issue #32429. Guide goes to /guide, Buy goes to /buy. Do not imply the description link is deleted.
theme: Bauhaus product poster: cream, red, yellow and black; separate description link and purchase button.
